items.title: Iran War Live Updates: Strikes in Beirut, Ship Attacks Near Strait of Hormuz and Oil Supply News
items.title_zh: 伊朗戰爭最新：貝魯特遭空襲 海峽附近船隻遇襲 油供應受關注
items.desc: The fighting in the Middle East showed no sign of letup, as the Pentagon told Congress that the first six days of the war had cost the U.S. at least $11.3 billion.
items.desc_zh: 中東戰火持續，五角大樓向國會表示戰爭首六天已耗費美國至少113億美元。

items.title: Iran war live: Israel hits Lebanon, Hormuz fears rise, Gulf states attacked
items.title_zh: 伊朗戰爭直播：以色列轟炸黎巴嫩 海灣國家遭襲 霍爾木茲海峽擔憂加劇
items.desc: Iran accuses the US and Israel of targeting civilians, saying more than 1,300 have been killed across the country since the war began.
items.desc_zh: 伊朗指控美國和以色列瞄準平民，稱自戰爭開始以來已有超過1300人在全國遇難。

items.title: What we know on the 12th day of the US and Israel's war with Iran
items.title_zh: 美國與以色列伊朗戰爭第12天：我們知道些什麼
items.desc: Israel said it launched "large-scale" strikes in Lebanon after coming under attack from "dozens of rockets" launched by the Iranian-backed militant group Hezbollah.
items.desc_zh: 以色列表示，在遭受伊朗支持的真主黨武裝組織發射的「數十枚火箭」攻擊後，對黎巴嫩發動了「大規模」襲擊。

items.title: Iran Update Evening Special Report, March 10, 2026
items.title_zh: 伊朗戰況晚間特別報告 2026年3月10日
items.desc: Hezbollah claimed 29 attacks targeting IDF forces and positions in northern Israel and southern Lebanon between 3:00 PM ET on March 9 and 3:00 PM ET on March 10.
items.desc_zh: 真主黨宣稱在3月9日下午3時至3月10日下午3時（美國東部時間）期間，對以色列國防軍在以色列北部和黎巴嫩南部的軍隊和陣地發動了29次襲擊。

items.title: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, March 9, 2026
items.title_zh: 俄羅斯進攻評估 2026年3月9日
items.desc: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated on March 9 that the United States asked to postpone the US-Ukrainian-Russian negotiations originally planned for this week due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.
items.desc_zh: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基3月9日表示，由於中東持續衝突，美國要求推遲原定本週舉行的美烏俄談判。

items.title: 中国政府为何向国内几家最大银行注资3000亿元人民币？
items.title_zh: 中国政府为何向国内几家最大银行注资3000亿元人民币？
items.desc: In the midst of the ongoing real estate crisis, the Chinese government will inject 300 billion yuan into state-owned banks. Premier Li Qiang announced this in the annual government work report to the National People's Congress.
items.desc_zh: 在房地產危機持續蔓延之際，中国政府将向国有银行注资3000亿元人民币。国务院总理李强在全国人大上作的年度政府工作报告中宣布了这一消息。

items.title: 中国自主研发的世界最强超高强度碳纤维今日首发
items.title_zh: 中国自主研发的世界最强超高强度碳纤维今日首发
items.desc: China's independently developed T1200 ultra-high-strength carbon fiber will be globally launched on March 11. This breakthrough fills a gap in the global field and marks a major leap in ultra-high-strength carbon fiber production.
items.desc_zh: 据央视新闻报道，3月11日，中国自主研发的T1200级超高强度碳纤维将全球首发。这一突破填补了全球相关领域的空白，标志着中国在超高强度碳纤维生产领域实现了重大跨越。

items.title: 中国科技部长：十五五'时期是加快实现高水平科技自立自强的关键时期
items.title_zh: 中国科技部长：十五五'时期是加快实现高水平科技自立自强的关键时期
items.desc: China's Minister of Science and Technology Yin Hejun said that the '15th Five-Year Plan' period is crucial for accelerating high-level technological self-reliance. China's innovation index ranking has risen to 10th globally.
items.desc_zh: 科技部部长阴和俊表示，十五五时期是加快实现高水平科技自立自强的关键时期。中国科技实力跃上新台阶，创新指数排名上升至全球第10位。

items.title: 巴拿马港口争端升级，中国约谈马士基和地中海航运
items.title_zh: 巴拿马港口争端升级，中国约谈马士基和地中海航运
items.desc: China's Ministry of Transport has summoned executives from the world's two largest container shipping companies, in what industry sources say is related to their role in the Panama port dispute.
items.desc_zh: 中国交通运输部已约谈全球两家最大的集装箱航运公司高管，业内消息人士称，此举与它们在巴拿马港口争端中所扮演的角色有关。

items.title: 中国海关总署：前2个月中国货物贸易进出口增长18.3%
items.title_zh: 中国海关总署：前2个月中国货物贸易进出口增长18.3%
items.desc: According to customs statistics, in the first two months of 2026, China's total trade in goods reached 7.73 trillion yuan, a year-on-year growth of 18.3%.
items.desc_zh: 据海关统计，2026年前2个月，中国货物贸易进出口总值7.73万亿元人民币，同比增长18.3%。其中，出口4.62万亿元，增长19.2%；进口3.11万亿元，增长17.1%。

items.title: 港驻英经贸办间谍案 卫志梁借黑帮骚扰郑文杰
items.title_zh: 港驻英经贸办间谍案 卫志梁借黑帮骚扰郑文杰
items.desc: The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in London spy case continues in UK court. The prosecution revealed that defendant Derek Lo had requested help from the 14K triad to target Zheng Wenjie, founder of the UK Hong Kong Association.
items.desc_zh: 香港驻伦敦经贸办间谍案继续在英国法庭审讯。控方披露被告卫志梁曾声称「阿爷」指示黑帮「14K」成员以「五金花五棍」方式教训英国港侨协会创办人郑文杰。

items.title: 時事全方位｜的士電子支付(二)
items.title_zh: 時事全方位｜的士電子支付(二)
items.desc: Starting next month, taxis must provide at least two types of electronic payment methods. About 90% of active drivers have already installed systems.
items.desc_zh: 的士下月起必須提供最少兩種電子支付方式，在活躍司機中目前約9成已安裝。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS Holdings (NASDAQ:GDS) Receives Average Rating of 'Moderate Buy' from Brokerages
items.title_zh: 萬國數據 GDS 獲得分析師「適度買入」平均評級
items.desc: Shares of GDS Holdings have earned an average recommendation of 'Moderate Buy' from twelve analysts. The average 12-month target price is $47.91.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據股票獲得12位分析師的平均「適度買入」評級。12個月平均目標價為47.91美元。

items.title: GDS Holdings Position Increased by Infini Capital Management Ltd
items.title_zh: Infini Capital Management 增加萬國數據持倉
items.desc: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board boosted its holdings in GDS by 77.7% during the second quarter, now owning 7,004,083 shares worth $214,115,000.
items.desc_zh: 加拿大退休金計劃投資委員會在第二季度將萬國數據持倉增加77.7%，現持有7,004,083股，價值2.14億美元。

items.title: Monolith Management Ltd Purchases 43,433 Shares of GDS Holdings
items.title_zh: Monolith Management 購買萬國數據股票
items.desc: Aspex Management HK Ltd lifted its stake in GDS by 46.4% in the 2nd quarter, now owning 4,406,949 shares valued at $134,720,000.
items.desc_zh: Aspex Management HK Ltd在第二季度將萬國數據持股增加46.4%，現持有4,406,949股，價值1.35億美元。

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To GDS Holdings Tripling CEO Super-Voting Power
items.title_zh: 投資者如何看待萬國數據 CEO 超級投票權增至三倍
items.desc: GDS Holdings approved amendments increasing CEO William Wei Huang's voting power from 20 to 50 votes per Class B share, materially concentrating control.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據批准修正案，將CEO黃偉祥的B類股票投票權從每股20票增至50票，實質上集中了控制權。

items.title: GDS Updates Hong Kong Disclosure and Confirms Regulatory Waivers
items.title_zh: 萬國數據更新香港披露並確認監管豁免
items.desc: GDS Holdings has updated its public company information sheet in Hong Kong as of March 10, 2026, detailing regulatory disclosures.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據截至2026年3月10日已更新香港公開公司資料表，詳列監管披露事項。

items.title: OpenClaw - Wikipedia
items.title_zh: OpenClaw - 維基百科
items.desc: On March 8, 2026, Shenzhen's Longgang District released a draft policy supporting OpenClaw use, while Chinese authorities moved to restrict state-run enterprises from running OpenClaw AI apps.
items.desc_zh: 2026年3月8日，深圳龍崗區發布支持OpenClaw使用的草案政策，同時中國當局對央企使用OpenClaw AI應用進行限制。

items.title: Meta acquired Moltbook, the AI agent social network that went viral because of fake posts
items.title_zh: Meta 收購因假帖子走紅的 AI 代理社交網絡 Moltbook
items.desc: Meta acquired Moltbook, the Reddit-like social network where AI agents using OpenClaw can communicate. The viral OpenClaw project creator Peter Steinberger has since joined OpenAI.
items.desc_zh: Meta收購了Moltbook，這個AI代理可使用OpenClaw相互溝通的類似Reddit的社交網絡。OpenClaw項目創始人Peter Steinberger已加入OpenAI。

items.title: China Moves to Limit Use of OpenClaw AI at Banks, Government Agencies
items.title_zh: 中國限制銀行和政府機構使用 OpenClaw AI
items.desc: Chinese authorities moved to restrict state-run enterprises and government agencies from running OpenClaw AI apps on office computers, acting swiftly to defuse potential security risks.
items.desc_zh: 中國當局迅速行動，限制央企和政府機構在辦公電腦上運行OpenClaw AI應用，以化解潛在的安全風險。

items.title: Chinese tech hubs promote OpenClaw AI agent despite security warnings
items.title_zh: 中國科技園區無視安全警告 推廣 OpenClaw AI 代理
items.desc: Local governments in several Chinese tech and manufacturing hubs have announced measures to build an industry around OpenClaw, even as regulators warn of security risks.
items.desc_zh: 多個中國科技和製造中心的當地政府宣布了围绕OpenClaw構建產業的措施，即使監管機構警告存在安全風險。

items.title: Meet OpenClaw: The AI assistant that broke every record – and started a security panic
items.title_zh: 認識 OpenClaw：打破所有紀錄的 AI 助手 並引發安全恐慌
items.desc: In March 2026, this AI assistant became the fastest-growing open-source project in history, surpassing 250,000 GitHub stars – a milestone that took Linux years to reach.
items.desc_zh: 2026年3月，這款AI助手成為歷史增長最快的開源項目，突破25萬GitHub星標——這一里程碑Linux花了多年才達成。
